Population increased in Adur

The estimated population of Adur in 2024 was 64,889 usual residents, a rise of 0.3% since 2023.

This meant that Adur's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Adur increased by 0.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Adur was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Adur

The average (median) age stayed at 46 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Adur has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Adur is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Adur's population of 64,889 usual residents was made up of:

  • 11,478 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.7%)
  • 37,815 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.3%)
  • 15,596 people aged 65 years and over, (24%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Adur has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (24% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Adur, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Adur
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Adur, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 189 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 494 births and 683 deaths in Adur.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 223 (0.3%). There were 3,902 people entering the area and 3,679 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Adur's population of 165 (0.3%) as a result of 241 people entering the area and 76 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Adur was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Adur in mid-2023 is 64,688.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 24 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 23 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1 person.
